subject: Geopolitics
title: Social Media as Intelligence
description: One-minute skill: Social Media as Intelligence.

hook.text: Russian troop buildups before the Ukraine invasion were tracked on TikTok by teenagers, not by spy satellites.

buildup.text: Social media is an intelligence goldmine. Soldiers post selfies near weapons. Citizens film military convoys.

discovery.text: Geolocation of photos and metadata analysis can pinpoint troop positions from a single uploaded image.

twist.text: Adversaries plant false social media content to mislead analysts. Every post must be verified, which takes time.

climax.text: Social media turns every smartphone user into an unwitting intelligence source. Privacy is the real casualty.

punchline.text: Your selfie is someone else's intelligence report.

quiz.question: How did social media contribute to intelligence during the Ukraine invasion?
options: Governments used it to send coded messages
Civilians and soldiers posted content revealing troop movements
Social media platforms shared data directly with NATO
